# Version 4.152.3
> **RAW decoder retirement** · Released September 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.3) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.3)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.203/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.3 retires built-in RAW and DNG decoding, including embedded JPEG preview extraction.

## Breaking Changes

- **Decode RAW and DNG outside SkiaSharp** — Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of JPEG previews from RAW containers are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode or convert these files with another library before using SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5188](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5188))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.203

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
